listing.name: Phillip Andrada Gas Station Manager
listing.summary: Let Phillip Andrada live out his true dream: Being the best damned Dictator Gas Station Manager on this side of the Persean Sector. Complete with more lively market music to all his customers coming to the various Sindrian Fuel Company™ gas stations in the Askonia star system.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction centered around a gas station manager and his fleet.

description:
"My loyal customers, my hardworking employees, my friends! These past twenty-five cycles have been a tumultuous time for us all. Yet despite this, we continue to move forward! Though there are those who continue to doubt us, the Sindrian Fuel Company has shown no sign of slowing down! The results are in and thanks to me, Sindrian-brand Antimatter Fuel continues to be the most popular brand in the Persean Sector! I thank you all for your continued support, and may we continue to prove to all that Sindrian Antimatter Fuel is the best for this cycle and every cycle beyond! So remember, buy Sindrian! Or Else!" - The Magnanimous, Excellent, Glorious and Auspicious Supreme Chief Overlord President Executive Gas Station Manager Phillip Andrada's State of the Company Address circa c206.01.01.

Art by the Wonderful Luzaitis
Not Shpiner for creating a wonderful Sindrian Fuel Advertisement!

PLEASE START A NEW SAVE TO SEE ALL THE NEW FEATURES OF EACH MAJOR UPDATE.
Download v1.14.1a (INCOMPATIBLE WITH V0.97 STARSECTOR and V1.14.1 AND BELOW OF PAGSM)

Let Phillip Andrada live out his true dream: Being the best damned Dictator Gas Station Manager on this side of the Persean Sector.
Complete with more lively market music to all his customers coming to the various Sindrian Fuel Company™ gas stations in the Askonia star system.

Preview the fleet and weapons that will ensure that no outlaws or jealous rivals will stop you with the might of the Sindrian Fuel Fleet!
Please do not redistribute derivative works without permission.

Previews
Spoiler

Looking to take your support for the Sindrian Diktat Fuel Company to the next level? Why not get Diktat Enhancement to go along with your Lobsters and Fuel?

Music sourced from Tropic 1 and 3

Mods that affect the Sindrian Diktat .faction file may cause crashes.
v1.14.1a is not save game compatible. Please start a new save to experience the entirety of the mod to its fullest.

PAGSM has some amount of crossmod interaction with these mods. Thanks to the original mod makers, check out these mods!
Spoiler
PAGSM Crossmod List:

Crossmod with added mechanics:
Diktat Enhancement (Integration with new planets and changes. Please use latest version.)
Nexerelin (Planet change description / HVP trade in rep reward / Unique Alliance Names/ Modified faction relationships)
Substance Abuse (Gift drinks to NPCs)
Combat Chatter (Unique Combat Chatter personalities for unique officers)

United Auroran Federation (Gift UAF goods to NPCs/ Captured Planet Descriptions with Nexerelin/ Unique Alliance Name)
Secrets of the Frontier (Unique Sierra Interactions/ Custom Askonia miniquest)
Interstellar Imperium (Gift Byzantine Wine/ Unique Alliance Name)
Oculian Armada (Gift Oculian Cookies)
Special Hullmod Upgrades (Special Hullmods for PAGSM colony items. Please get latest version.)
Custom Battle Music (Adds a combat track for when fighting SFC fleets)
Arma Amatura (Adds strikecraft variants of mechs in PAGSM)
Take No Prisoner (Special Prisoner Interactions with specific unique officers)

Crossmod with description changes:
Iron Shell (Unique Alliance Name/ Captured Planet Description)
Shadowyards Reconstruction Authority (Unique Alliance Name/ Captured Planet Descriptions)
Star Federation (Unique Alliance Name/ Captured Planet Descriptions)
Volkov Industrial Conglomorate (Unique Alliance Name/ Captured Planet Descriptions)
Machina Void Shipyards (Captured Planet Descriptions)
Mayasuran Navy (Unique Alliance Name)

Other Mod Recommendations

Also check out Interesting Portrait Packs for their cool portraits.

"My loyal customers, my hardworking employees, my friends! These past twenty-five cycles have been a tumultuous time for us all. Yet despite this, we continue to move forward! Though there are those who continue to doubt us, the Sindrian Fuel Company has shown no sign of slowing down! The results are in and thanks to me, Sindrian-brand Antimatter Fuel continues to be the most popular brand in the Persean Sector! I thank you all for your continued support, and may we continue to prove to all that Sindrian Antimatter Fuel is the best for this cycle and every cycle beyond! So remember, buy Sindrian! Or Else!" - The Magnanimous, Excellent, Glorious and Auspicious Supreme Chief Overlord President Executive Gas Station Manager Phillip Andrada's State of the Company Address circa c206.01.01.
Art by the Wonderful Luzaitis
Not Shpiner for creating a wonderful Sindrian Fuel Advertisement!

PLEASE START A NEW SAVE TO SEE ALL THE NEW FEATURES OF EACH MAJOR UPDATE.
Download v1.14.1a (INCOMPATIBLE WITH V0.97 STARSECTOR and V1.14.1 AND BELOW OF PAGSM)

Let Phillip Andrada live out his true dream: Being the best damned Dictator Gas Station Manager on this side of the Persean Sector.
Complete with more lively market music to all his customers coming to the various Sindrian Fuel Company™ gas stations in the Askonia star system.

Preview the fleet and weapons that will ensure that no outlaws or jealous rivals will stop you with the might of the Sindrian Fuel Fleet!
Please do not redistribute derivative works without permission.

PAGSM has some amount of crossmod interaction with these mods. Thanks to the original mod makers, check out these mods!
SpoilerPAGSM Crossmod List:

Crossmod with added mechanics:
Diktat Enhancement (Integration with new planets and changes. Please use latest version.)
Nexerelin (Planet change description / HVP trade in rep reward / Unique Alliance Names/ Modified faction relationships)

Combat Chatter (Unique Combat Chatter personalities for unique officers)

Oculian Armada (Gift Oculian Cookies)

Custom Battle Music (Adds a combat track for when fighting SFC fleets)

Take No Prisoner (Special Prisoner Interactions with specific unique officers)

discordPostHtml:
A mod which sees Supreme Executor Phillip Andrada embrace his true dream: Becoming the best damn gas station manager in the Persean Sector.
